Subject: Request: promo credits for next Catalyst cohort (12 teams)

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the quick live demo yesterday. Catalyst is kicking off Cohort 14 the week of Sep 6 and we have 12 early-stage teams who want to run POCs on Redwood for a 6-week trial.

Summary ask: would Redwood provide a one-time promo credit pool (recommended: 30K token credits split across 12 teams, ~2.5K tokens each) and extend trials to 45 days? The program is co-branded on our portal and we list Redwood as the default inference partner.

Attachments: catalyst_proposal_v2.pdf (pdf, 220KB) — includes program blurb and expected usage profile.

Key constraints:
- Teams are mainly prototype workloads: chat+few-shot generation, light embeddings for search
- Data sensitivity: non-production demo data only; some teams will need SOC2 evidence

If you can poke the right ops/credits flow and share a lightweight acceptance (SLA/usage guardrails), we can start onboarding immediately.

Best,
Anna Ruiz
Partnerships Manager, Catalyst Labs
anna@catalystlabs.org

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Catalyst's ask. Quick summary below and my proposed approach.

Why: high signal accelerator partner, consistent pipeline of early-stage POCs; public co-branding ups net-new awareness.

Ask from Catalyst: 30K token credits total (approx 2.5K each) + trial extension to 45 days.

My suggested guardrails:
- Issue a single voucher code redeemable once per team, expires 45 days after activation
- Per-team cap: 3K tokens; notify account owner at 80% usage
- SOC2 note: share SOC2 summary + audit contact before onboarding

Operational steps I think we need:
1) Approve credit pool and duration (ops/finance)
2) Legal signoff on co-branded program blurb (minimal risk)
3) Create voucher codes and a simple redemption flow for Catalyst portal
4) Add rate limits and alerting for unusual usage

I'm happy to own coordination with Catalyst. If approved, I'll attach the cohort allocation sheet and kick off voucher generation.

Priya
